# PublicViews
**Type:** Measurement  
**Referenced in:** 1 paper  

## State of the Field

A dataset extracted from TwinViews-13k containing political statements across 31 topics and explicitness variants for evaluating political bias and factuality in generated news.

## Sources

**[Fair or Framed? Political Bias in News Articles Generated by LLMs](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.856.pdf)**
